tests_written.rationale: Adversarial tests cover immutable inputs, read-only and write modes, actual changed paths, timeout, cancellation, and terminal receipts.

tests_passed.rationale: All eight delegate contract tests exited zero and are repeated by the release gate.

persistence_real.rationale: Tests use real Git worktrees, filesystem locks, immutable packet files, process termination, and atomic receipts.

feature_flags_audit.rationale: Permissions are explicit per-run authority, not default-off feature availability.

vertical_slice.rationale: The public delegate entrypoint launches a child, validates native output and Git changes, and publishes a terminal receipt.

spec_trace.rationale: The architecture anchor defines authority, process, output, recovery, and host-profile boundaries.

limitations: No authenticated provider call is claimed; provider quality and quota behavior require separate authorization.
